name: R028-explosion-draw
why: Challenge 7. All three player Pokemon have Explosion in slot 0: Weezing (597), Metagross (832), Electrode (588), each faster than all three opponents (Vileplume 586, Exeggutor 534, Machamp 808: no Protect, Detect, Endure, Substitute, evasion, Focus Band, Quick Claw, Damp, Intimidate, priority move, Ghost/Rock/Steel type). Each Explosion knocks out its target even on the lowest roll (Defense halved), so turn by turn one Pokemon of each side faints; on turn 3 the last two faint in the same action, Cmd_checkteamslost ORs LOST and WON, and the outcome maps to a draw. Weezing (the slowest exploder) leads against the slowest opponent, Vileplume.
